item.title: A Nagoya Meshi Food Tour: Eating Through Japan's Boldest Food City — Guide
item.description: No Japanese city guards a food identity as fiercely as Nagoya, whose ‘Nagoya meshi’ canon — eel hitsumabushi, miso-sauced katsu, peppery tebasaki wings, clay-pot miso nikomi udon, morning ogura toast and more — grew from the region’s dark hatcho miso and tamari brewing traditions into a cuisine found nowhere else. Eating through it is the city’s best itinerary: a self-guided day can run from kissaten breakfast through a noodle lunch to an izakaya wing crawl, while guided evening food tours thread the lantern-lit alleys and counter bars with a local who knows which queue is worth it.
